Blasters are a special kind of plasma weapon. They inflict relatively low damage and Armour Destruction compared to plasma weapons, but are more accurate, fire faster, and have increased Armour Penetration and ammo capacity.

Blaster bolts are more compact than an equivalent plasma bolt, and have a shorter optimal range. However, they are not as heavily affected by range dropoff penalties, and therefore still have a higher maximum range. This assault blaster has a dropoff rate of 10% per tile.

Blasters recovered on the battlefield are DNA-locked and cannot be used by human units. Xenonaut engineers can eventually defeat the DNA lock and create human-usable Blasters, but they cannot be upgraded further.
